=== web/src/lib/shell/nav.generated.ts ===
// Starting point (web-svelte): the navigation entries the plugins composed with the shell declared,
// written once. It is yours from here on; routes add their own entries through a nav.ts beside them.
// Add a page to the nav with a sibling nav.ts, not here (see the svelte-shell skill).
import { buildNav } from './nav';
import type { NavMeta } from './types';

/**
 * Entries contributed by plugins through the web.nav slot. With no contribution the composer
 * renders the placeholder as nothing, not as [], so concat takes zero arguments then.
 */
const pluginNav = ([] as NavMeta[]).concat([{"label":"Account","order":900,"group":"user"}]);

/** Every app-owned nav.ts under src/routes, collected at build time. */
const routeNavModules = import.meta.glob('/src/routes/**/nav.ts', { eager: true });

export const navGroups = buildNav(pluginNav, routeNavModules);

=== web/src/lib/shell/nav.test.ts ===
=== web/src/lib/shell/nav.ts ===
=== web/src/lib/shell/providers.generated.ts ===
// Starting point (web-svelte): the providers and route guards the plugins composed with the shell
// declared, written once. It is yours from here on: add or remove entries as the app needs.
// Identifiers resolve against the scope in ./scope (see the
// svelte-shell skill).
import { checkGuards, checkProviders } from './guard';
import { scope } from './scope';

const { DataProvider, StubProvider } = scope;
const { stubGuard } = scope;

/** Provider components, outermost first. */
export const providers = checkProviders([DataProvider, StubProvider]);

/** Route guards. The slot is single-valued, so this holds zero or one. */
export const routeGuards = checkGuards([stubGuard]);
